findings.issue: Advisory lock serializes ALL parallel clone operations, but ADR §4.3 specifies it is only needed to protect against concurrent setup-template. Postgres allows parallel CREATE DATABASE … TEMPLATE without mutual exclusion. Result: conservative but safe. No functional defect.
findings.suggestion: Post-approve: advisory lock scope can be narrowed so parallel fitness:db runs clone concurrently. Lock only when setup-template is active.

findings.issue: Hardcoded password placeholder 'pw' in selfTest() utility. Used only in --self-test path for URL-rewriting check (no real connection). Not a real secret, but visually ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Rename to obvious placeholder like 'PLACEHOLDER' or 'x' to signal it is not a real credential.
